method: Manual Figure75 source-stroke guides trace original maxRGB<=45 JPEG pixels. Four explicitly enumerated blue-label-overprint intervals use low-confidence bounded manual continuations with unselected alternative paths; twenty vertices are not strict source-black observations. No source-frame closure, buffer, repair, geographic snap or simplification is used. A photo-only Figure74-to-Figure75 affine uses six fitted and seven held-out texture patches, with all fourteen rejected searches and preliminary attempts retained. Its inverse is composed with the archived Figure74-to-Figure73 photo relation and the Figure73 EOV metric calibration. Both photographic relations and the six original Figure73 manual image observations/literal OSM coordinates are independently refitted. The entire new cell is beyond observed overlap and the calibration image footprints. Source-text overprints and full geographic placement remain explicit inferences; photographic residuals are not absolute boundary accuracy.
